title: Fix memory gateway error handling — GetPageAsync, CreatePageAsync, LocalKnowledgeResolver
description:
**Source:** Internal audit Sprint 60 (2026-07-11) — MSA-MEM-001/002/003 + new findings

Three memory gateway methods lack adequate error handling:
1. `LocalKnowledgeResolver.ResolveAsync` (~line 88) — calls `memory.SearchAsync` with zero try/catch. Transient HTTP failure crashes the pipeline.
2. `RestMemoryGateway.CreatePageAsync` (~line 95) — `EnsureSuccessStatusCode()` throws on 4xx/5xx with no error handling.
3. `RestMemoryGateway.GetPageAsync` (~line 70-73) — returns null on any non-success HTTP status; callers cannot distinguish 404 from 401/403/500. Also no transport-level error handling for DNS/TLS failures.
4. `RestMemoryGateway.UpdatePageAsync` (~lines 110, 131) — both PUT branches call `EnsureSuccessStatusCode()` with no try/catch.

**Recommendation:** Add try/catch for `HttpRequestException` and `TaskCanceledException` with warning logging to all methods. For GetPageAsync, log warnings for non-404 status codes and only return null on 404.
